title: 第2176章 镇域真意第2175章 五兵初融
slug: 镇守仙秦地牢吞妖六十年
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：镇守仙秦：地牢吞妖六十年第一卷：默认第2176章镇域真意（..la）缩小后的炎鞭只有不到两尺长，暗沉古朴，看起来像一条被磨损了无数岁月的旧皮带。
但他的指尖触碰到鞭身的瞬间，一股微弱而炽烈的脉动便顺着指腹传入掌心。
那是炎鞭的兵灵在回应他。
他闭上眼。
心神沉入体内。
丹田中，虚影长刀静静地悬浮着。
刀身上流转着五色光芒。
镇岳的沉厚土黄、寒矛的柔韧水蓝、破渊剑的银白、玄霜之刃的暗金、长枪的锋锐青芒。
五股力量交织成一道稳固的循环，沿着他的经脉缓缓流淌。
他引导着这股力量，延伸向握着炎鞭的手指。
指尖处，一缕五色光芒渗入鞭身。
炎鞭的兵灵在一瞬间做出了回应。
不是被动的接受。
是一种急切而渴望的迎接。
像一个在无尽黑暗中被封印了数十万年的囚徒，终于听到了同族的呼唤，用尽所有力气扑向那道缝隙中透进来的光芒。
赤红色的光芒从鞭身上涌出，沿着张远的手指、手臂、经脉，一节一节地向体内蔓延。
那股力量带着灼热的温度，像是一条烧红的铁链在他的经脉中蜿蜒前行。
但与外在的灼热不同，那股力量的内部却温和而纯正。
仿佛一块被烈日暴晒了一整天的石头，外表滚烫，内核却保存着大地深处最恒定的温度。
炎鞭的力量，汇入了体内的五色循环。

在进入的那一瞬间，虚影长刀的刀身微微一震。
五色光芒与赤红色光芒在刀身上碰撞了一瞬。
然后，五色光芒主动让开了一条通道。
赤红色的光芒顺着那条通道，找到了属于自己的位置。
镇岳的沉厚在外，寒矛的柔韧在内，那两股力量交汇后的空隙中，炎鞭的力量自然而然地填入，严丝合缝。
像一枚拼图的最后一块，被放入了它本就该在的位置。
然而，就在这五股力量完全贯通的瞬间，张远的意识深处，忽然感受到了一股极其微弱的震颤。
那震颤不是来自外界。
是来自封印之兵本身。
在他握住炎鞭、完成五兵循环的那一刻，一股被封印在兵灵最深处的、属于兵主时代的意志片段，如同沉在水底的泥沙被搅动了一般，悄然翻涌上来。
那是一片模糊的、破碎的画面。
他看到了一柄刀。
不是他见过的任何一柄封印之兵。
那柄刀的刀身漆黑如渊，刀背上镶嵌着九枚暗金色的骨片，每一枚骨片上都刻着一个他看不懂的古老符文。
那柄刀悬浮在一片混沌虚空之中，刀身上流转着一股让他心悸的力量。
那不是单纯的杀意，不是单纯的毁灭，而是一种更高层次的东西。
那柄刀周围，有九道模糊的虚影在环绕。
那些虚影的姿态各异，有的持刀，有的握剑，有的举锤，有的挥鞭。
他能认出其中的几道。
那气息与镇岳、寒矛、炎鞭如出一辙。

九道虚影围绕着那柄漆黑长刀旋转，每旋转一圈，虚影就淡薄一分，而漆黑长刀上的光芒就亮一分。
那是九兵合一的过程。

Recommended reading for all book friends: Guarding the Immortal Qin: Swallowing Demons in the Dungeon for Sixty Years Volume 1: Default Chapter 2176 The True Meaning of the Town (..la) The shrunken flame whip is less than two feet long, dull and simple, and looks like an old belt that has been worn for countless years.
But the moment his fingertips touched the whip body, a weak but fierce pulse was transmitted along the fingertips into the palm of his hand.
That was the soldier spirit of Flame Whip responding to him.
He closed his eyes.
The mind sank into the body.
In the dantian, the long phantom sword floated quietly.
Five colors of light flowed on the blade.
The thick earthy yellow of the Zhenyue, the flexible aqua blue of the Cold Spear, the silvery white of the Yuanyuan Sword, the dark gold of the Xuanshuang Blade, and the sharp green light of the spear.
The five forces intertwined into a stable circulation, flowing slowly along his meridians.
He guided this power and extended it to the fingers holding the flaming whip.
At the fingertips, a ray of five-color light seeped into the whip body.
The soldier spirit of Flame Whip responded in an instant.
It is not a passive acceptance.
It is an eager and eager welcome.
Like a prisoner who had been sealed in the endless darkness for hundreds of thousands of years, he finally heard the call of his fellow humans and used all his strength to pounce on the light coming from the gap.
Red light gushed out from the whip, spreading along Zhang Yuan's fingers, arms, and meridians, section by section, into the body.
That power carried a scorching temperature, like a red-hot iron chain snaking through his meridians.
But unlike the burning heat on the outside, the power inside is gentle and pure.
It is like a stone that has been exposed to the scorching sun all day long. It is hot on the outside, but the core retains the most constant temperature deep in the earth.
The power of the flame whip merges into the five-color circulation in the body.
At the moment of entering, the blade of the phantom sword shook slightly.
The five-color light and the crimson light collided on the blade for a moment.
Then, the five-color light took the initiative to make way for a passage.
The crimson light followed the passage and found its own place.
The thickness of Zhenyue is on the outside, and the flexibility of the cold spear is on the inside. In the gap between the two forces, the power of the flame whip naturally fills in, making a perfect fit.
Like the last piece of a puzzle, it was placed where it was supposed to be.
However, at the moment when these five forces were completely penetrated, Zhang Yuan suddenly felt an extremely weak tremor deep in his consciousness.
The tremor didn't come from outside.
It comes from the sealed weapon itself.
The moment he grasped the flame whip and completed the cycle of five soldiers, a fragment of will that was sealed in the deepest part of the soldier spirit and belonged to the era of the soldier master quietly surged up like the sand at the bottom of the water being stirred up.
It was a blurry, broken picture.
He saw a knife.
It was not any sealed weapon he had ever seen.
The blade of the knife was as black as an abyss, and the back of the knife was inlaid with nine dark golden bone fragments. Each bone fragment was engraved with an ancient rune that he could not understand.
The knife was suspended in a chaotic void, and there was a power flowing on the knife that made his heart palpitate.
It was not a simple murderous intention, not a simple destruction, but something of a higher level.
There were nine blurry shadows surrounding the knife.
The phantoms have different postures, some are holding knives, some are holding swords, some are holding hammers, and some are waving whips.
He could recognize several of them.
That aura is exactly the same as Zhenyue, Cold Spear, and Flame Whip.
Nine phantoms revolved around the long black knife. Every time it rotated, the shadows became fainter and the light on the long black knife became brighter.
That is the process of nine soldiers uniting into one.
